findings: 42/42 closed trades were 'aggressive-exploration' entries taken while EMA20<EMA50 with negative 24h change (-0.2% to -10%): every entry was counter-trend in a downtrend regime.

Entries cluster: 4 coins entered in the same 5-min run each time (03:20, 05:49, 08:23, 11:16, 13:18, 15:16, 00:21, 02:50, 04:16, 07:00 UTC), so each bad signal cost 4x; correlated losses, not diversification.
Net -2068.75 = gross -945.70 minus fees 1123.03. Taker 0.6% each side (1.2% round trip) is 54% of the loss; 8 of 40 losers were gross-positive and fee-killed.
Targets were ~5.5-7% away with a 2h max hold: only 4/40 losers ever reached half the target (median MFE ~0.6%). Target was unreachable in the hold window; 30/42 exits were time-exits.
Stops were 1.25-1.6x ATR; all 12 quote-stops hit within 1-2h in -2% to -6% hourly flushes (e.g. 02:50 batch, MAE ~-6%). Too tight for downtrend volatility.
Untagged entries (no pattern match): 35 trades, 0 wins, -1980.81. Pattern-tagged: oversold-bounce 1/5, ma20-reclaim 1/2 (the only 2 winners, both with 2-4h holds and MFE >3.6%).
